_about: Feature definitions for observe.py learn, format_version 1: which image regions of which camera hold the aiming dot, the wire tip and the seam, and the detector thresholds.
Copy it beside cameras.json (for example ~/gpo-setup/features.json) and replace every FILL_ME. learn refuses this file while any FILL_ME remains.
Read ROI pixel coordinates from a stored frame: observe.py export-frame SESSION_DIR --camera cam_a --out cam_a.png (x is the column and y the row of the region's top-left corner).
Tune thresholds with observe.py learn record --backend cameras ...; its feature-summary.json shows each value's valid fraction, spread and confidence.
Observation values are named <camera_id>.<label>.<key>: u and v (pixels) for dot and wire, theta_deg and rho for a seam line x cos(theta) + y sin(theta) = rho.

Detector defaults, for reference only: dot threshold_sigma 6, min_pixels 3, max_pixels 20000; wire threshold_sigma 5, min_pixels 30, min_elongation 3; seam inlier_px 1, min_inlier_fraction 0.6, min_edge_sigma 5.
Check with: tools/cad-venv/bin/python tools/gun-positioner-observation/observe.py learn check --features features.json --cameras cameras.json. Keys starting with _ are notes.
frames_per_observation: FILL_ME: frames averaged into one observation per camera
min_valid_fraction: FILL_ME: fraction of those frames that must yield a value (0-1)
settle_s: FILL_ME: seconds after a move's completion before frames count

params.channel: FILL_ME: red, green, blue or gray

params.approach_deg: FILL_ME: image direction from the tip back along the wire, 0 = +x, 90 = +y
